summary.text: Bruno Barreiro is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 113 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent that also includes Democrat Gloria Romero Roses and write-in candidate Paola Vazquez del Mercado.
He served on the Miami-Dade County Commission, representing District 5, from 1998 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Bruno Barreiro assumed office on the Miami-Dade County Commission, District 5, in 1998 and left office on March 31, 2018.
In 2018 he ran in the Republican primary for U.S. House Florida District 27 and finished second with 25.7% of the vote behind Maria Elvira Salazar.
In 2020 he was the Republican candidate for Florida House District 112 and lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Nick Duran, 53.0% to 47.0%.
He also appeared on the ballot in the 2021 Miami Board of Commissioners District 3 general election, in which incumbent Joe Carollo won.
In 2026 Barreiro won the Republican primary for House District 113 with 42.4% of the vote (2,431 votes), defeating Frank Lago and Tony Diaz.
